scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n mcp,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:mcp" "npm run wait:mcp && npm run dev:web"
scripts.start:prod: concurrently -k -n mcp,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:mcp" "npm run wait:mcp && npm run build -w @proofwork/web && npm run start -w @proofwork/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @proofwork/shared && npm run build -w @proofwork/web && npm run build -w @proofwork/mcp
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @proofwork/web --if-present && npm run lint -w @proofwork/mcp --if-present && npm run lint -w @proofwork/shared --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @proofwork/shared --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @proofwork/web --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @proofwork/mcp --if-present
